findings.evidence: An older initial GET could finish after the post-create reload and overwrite its authoritative result.
findings.resolution: A monotonically increasing request version discards stale results and errors; a controlled two-request unit test covers the race.

findings.evidence: Initial widget coverage omitted option-removal selection shifts, in-flight disable, failure preservation, and success-to-reload lifecycle.
findings.resolution: Widget tests now cover removal before/at/after the selected answer, loading-disabled submit, preserved values, backend-created pop, and exactly one list reload.
